subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram provider intermittently stalls despite stable direct Bot API connectivity

question: Should Telegram SOCKS/HTTP proxy reliability be repaired through the open shared proxy-agent PR path, a maintainer replacement PR, or documented operator guidance only?
rationale: The source-backed gap is plausible, but the fix changes compatibility-sensitive shared proxy behavior and still needs live Telegram/proxy proof.

options.title: Repair the shared proxy path
options.body: Treat the issue as a real Telegram proxy reliability bug and require the open PR or replacement to cover explicit and env SOCKS/HTTP/HTTPS modes with live proof.

options.title: Wait for reporter repro
options.body: Keep the issue open but block implementation until a current-main service-context SOCKS5 reproduction is supplied.

options.title: Document workaround only
options.body: Close the engineering path if maintainers decide proxy-specific recovery is operator configuration rather than OpenClaw transport behavior.

recommendation.title: Repair the shared proxy path
recommendation.body: Treat the issue as a real Telegram proxy reliability bug and require the open PR or replacement to cover explicit and env SOCKS/HTTP/HTTPS modes with live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the shared Undici helper and Telegram transport policy surfaces.
